seasons.minimum_output: public problem register with affected users, non-AI baseline and candidate owner
seasons.kpi: 100% accepted issues have an owner, rights boundary and stop condition
seasons.cancel_if: owner, public purpose or affected-user route is absent

seasons.lead_role: authorized test operator and independent professional reviewers
seasons.minimum_output: bounded fixtures, negative results, takeover drill and return record
seasons.kpi: 100% high-risk tests exercise human stop and ordinary-route continuity
seasons.cancel_if: site, safety, permission, staffing or restoration resource is missing

seasons.minimum_output: release ticket, informed limited use, complaints and group-difference report
seasons.kpi: 100% public trials retain staffed and non-digital equivalent service
seasons.cancel_if: licence, public notice, complaint route or non-AI service fails

seasons.minimum_output: continue, modify, stop or return decision with reasons and asset/data disposition
seasons.kpi: 100% active scenes receive a published annual decision; unresolved serious incidents cannot roll over
seasons.cancel_if: independent review, deletion evidence or retirement responsibility is absent

cadence.weekly: maintainer triage for source, licence and reproducibility issues
cadence.monthly: operator review of incidents, complaints, accessibility and expired data
cadence.quarterly: public gate review with affected-user and professional representation
cadence.annual: publish continuation, modification, stop and return register; do not publish successes alone

resource_accounts: public value, complaints and opportunity cost
authority_boundary: Roles, cadence and targets are proposed operating requirements, not existing government arrangements, contracts, budgets or service commitments.
